# Tooltip

Short hint on hover (after 300 ms) and on keyboard focus, on bg-inverted.

`KenosUI.Tooltip` · Overlays

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Tooltip content={…}>…</KenosUI.Tooltip>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Tooltip" content="{{…}}">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

CSS tooltip on hover (300 ms delay) and focus. Hint on hover (300 ms) and keyboard focus, in the browser's top layer — never clipped by overflow, scroll containers or dialogs. Flips when there is no room. Esc closes.

## Props

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `placement` | `"top" \| "bottom"` |  |
| `openDelay` | `number` |  |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactElement` |  |
